name: Pashur
bio: Pashur son of Immer, a priest and chief officer of the temple, had Jeremiah beaten and put in stocks for prophesying Jerusalem's destruction. When released the next day, Jeremiah renamed him Magor-missabib ("terror on every side"), prophesying he would see his friends die by the sword and would himself die in exile in Babylon (Jeremiah 20:1-6).
